I want to help build the future of independent work.

I’ve helped scale billion-dollar technology businesses, built a successful independent business of my own, and coached others to do the same. Now I want to help build the technology that makes that possible for millions more people.

AI is making it easier to do work that once required entire teams. But for consultants, creators, coaches, and other independent professionals, the hard part is still figuring out what to sell, finding great customers, and building reliable income. I want to help solve those problems at scale.

Why this matters to me

At Pinterest I helped rebuild and scale Conversion Ads to a $1B+ annual revenue run rate. I built product marketing teams at AdRoll and led marketing at Gitcoin. Then, through Positive Sum, I built a $500K+ independent consulting business while creating more flexibility for family and life.

I’ve also spent five years coaching professionals and business owners. I’ve seen both what independence makes possible and how hard it can be to sustain. That’s the experience I want to combine with my product marketing and business-building background.

What I believe

The future of work is fluid.

People should be able to move between full-time employment, consulting, creating, and running their own businesses without starting from zero each time.

Doing the work is getting easier. Building the business is still hard.

The most valuable tools will help people choose the right customers, win their business, and maintain healthy, sustainable income.

Success should create freedom.

Help people earn well, work on what matters, and make room for family and the rest of life. Not everyone needs or wants to build a big company.

What I want to build with you

I want to partner closely with founders building for independent knowledge workers and creators. I bring customer discovery, positioning, new-market strategy, product marketing, and GTM leadership, plus firsthand experience of the customers we're serving.

I’m particularly excited about companies like Collective, HoneyBook, Kit, and LinkedIn, or emerging teams approaching the problem in a new way. The right work could span VP/Head of Product Marketing, marketing leadership, market expansion, or building a new business line. There doesn’t need to be an open role.

Know a founder I should meet?

  1. Introduce me to founders building for independent professionals. Especially those helping people find customers, monetize their expertise, or make smarter business decisions.
  2. Share ambitious teams and unposted opportunities. I’m looking for a founding team to build with, not just a particular title.

Based in the SF Bay Area; interested in Bay Area hybrid or remote teams with West Coast overlap. I’ll continue selective coaching and Positive Sum work on the side.
